stem: A single source-water EC reading is far above the recent trend, while plant and root-zone observations have not changed. What is the strongest immediate response?
choices: Rewrite the nutrient program from the one reading
Increase irrigation duration to dilute the source
Assume the crop has suddenly become salt tolerant
Repeat the measurement with a verified method and compare the source condition with recent records before making a management change
rationale: An isolated abnormal reading should be verified before driving a management change. Trend comparison and measurement confirmation help distinguish a real source-water change from a measurement problem.
